title: Human Handoff State
description: Structured state the guided human-setup flow writes and the milestone gate reads, so a milestone reaches validation without hidden assumptions. Secrets are references, never values. See docs/review/external-service-milestone-pattern.md section 7.

milestones.description: Keyed by milestone slug. Each holds the per-provider human steps that gate the milestone.

additionalProperties.description: Keyed by provider slug; the list of human steps for that provider in this milestone.

status.description: The gate requires every non-waived required step to be done.

required.description: Whether the gate blocks on this step (default true).

secret_ref.description: Reference to a secret, never its value (e.g. "gh:ANTHROPIC_API_KEY").
